goodnotes.title: GoodNotes notebooks
goodnotes.setup: In GoodNotes on your iPad, turn on Settings › Auto Backup as PDF to OneDrive, Google Drive or Dropbox, then choose that backup folder here.
goodnotes.readOnly: Backups are read-only copies, updated by GoodNotes.
reader.noOutline: This PDF has no table of contents.
reader.noBookmarks: No bookmarks yet. Press {shortcut} to bookmark the page you're on.
password.title: This PDF is protected
dark.toggleTitle: Dark mode ({shortcut}). Right-click for themes and adjustments
dark.offHint: Dark mode is off. The theme is used when you turn it on.
timer.title: Study timer

settings.title: Settings
settings.update.availableDetail: You have {current}. Download the new version from GitHub.
settings.update.availableSigned: You have {current}. It installs in a few seconds; your work is saved first.
settings.update.notReady: The update is still being prepared. Try again in a minute.
settings.update.readyAuto: Downloaded. It installs when you close LumiPDF, or restart now.
settings.update.modeHint: Automatically: downloaded in the background, installed when you close LumiPDF. Ask me first: you choose when.
settings.update.modePortable: The portable version can’t install updates itself; it opens the download page.
settings.update.betaUnlocked: Beta options unlocked: see Settings → General.
settings.update.betaAlready: Beta options are already on: see Settings → General.
settings.update.tapsLeft.one: {count} more click to unlock beta options
settings.update.tapsLeft.other: {count} more clicks to unlock beta options
settings.update.leaveText: You’re using a beta. LumiPDF {version} is the current stable version: switch to it now? Your documents, notes and settings are kept.
settings.update.leavePortable: You’re using a beta. LumiPDF {version} is the current stable version; download it from the releases page.
settings.update.leaveNone: There’s no stable version newer than this beta yet. You’ll get the stable version as soon as it’s released, and no more betas until then.
settings.update.betaHint: Try new features early. Betas can have rough edges.
settings.update.errorDetail: Check your internet connection and try again. You have {current}.
settings.update.idleDetail: Updates are checked when LumiPDF opens.
settings.startScreen.hint: What LumiPDF shows when it launches
settings.language.hint: Dates and numbers follow it too
settings.appearance.hint: The colours of LumiPDF itself. Pages use the reading theme.
settings.library.foldersHint: LumiPDF lists the PDFs in these folders. Removing a folder here never deletes files.
settings.about.text: A calm PDF reader for long study sessions, with a dark mode that keeps pages as sharp as the original.
settings.about.showWhatsNew: Show what’s new in this version
whatsnew.title: What’s new in LumiPDF {version}
cloud.title: Cloud drives
cloud.intro: Connect the cloud drives you use. LumiPDF reads the folder their desktop app keeps in sync, so nothing is uploaded and you don't sign in here.
cloud.notFound: Install the {name} desktop app, or choose its folder.
folders.sort.name: Name A–Z
settings.textClarity.hint: Slightly bolder text and no hairline thinner than a pixel. Helps on screens at 100% scaling.
settings.linkPreviews.hint: Hover a link to an equation, figure or footnote to see it without leaving your page.
settings.study.toolsHint: Timers, study stats and formula sheets. Turn off for a plain PDF reader.
settings.study.timerHint: Timer, Pomodoro, alarm and stopwatch in the top bar.
settings.study.statsHint: Counts your study time: the Today card, streaks and the Stats screen.
settings.study.sheetsHint: Collect snips on sheets to print for the exam.
study.hintText: Turn on timers, study stats and formula sheets.
study.hintDismiss: Don’t show again (it stays in Settings → General)
welcome.updates.title: How should LumiPDF update?
welcome.updates.text: New versions bring fixes and features. Your documents and notes are always kept.
welcome.updates.autoText: Downloaded quietly and installed when you close LumiPDF. Nothing to think about.
welcome.updates.askText: LumiPDF tells you about a new version and installs it when you click.
welcome.updates.later: You can change this in Settings → General.
welcome.usage.title: What will you use LumiPDF for?
welcome.usage.text: LumiPDF can be a study companion or a plain, quiet PDF reader.
welcome.usage.studyText: Timers and Pomodoro, study time and streaks, formula sheets from your snips.
welcome.usage.readText: Library, tabs, dark mode and annotations. Nothing else.
welcome.usage.later: You can change this any time in Settings → General → Study tools.
stats.resetText: All study time, streaks and rankings start again from zero. Your documents, reading progress, bookmarks, annotations and daily goal are kept.
stats.title: Study
stats.nothingYet: Nothing yet for this period. Time counts while a timer runs, or after 10 minutes of reading.
sheets.title: Formula sheets
sheets.cardEmpty: Snip a formula or figure in any PDF and choose Add to sheet. It lands here, ready to print.
sheets.name: Sheet name
sheets.flowHint: Snips line up in columns; drag to reorder
sheets.freeHint: Place every snip where you want it
sheets.tipText: In Auto, snips line up in columns on their own (drag to reorder). To place them anywhere on the page, switch to Free.
sheets.deleteConfirm: Delete “{title}”? Its snips are removed too. The PDFs they came from are not touched.
sheets.emptyText: Open a PDF, pick the snip tool (S), select a formula or figure and choose Add to sheet.
sheets.missing: This sheet can’t be found. It may have been deleted.
settings.library.goodnotesToggle: Show GoodNotes notebooks in the Library
settings.library.goodnotesHint: Shows your GoodNotes PDF exports in a card next to your formula sheets.
settings.library.notebooks.title: Card title
timer.alarmIdle: Pick a time and set the alarm.
timer.alarmNote: LumiPDF needs to stay open to ring; it can be minimized.
timer.longAfterMore: One more session before the long break
timer.longAfterLess: One session fewer before the long break
timer.studyNote: Timer, Pomodoro focus and Chrono count as study time. Reading alone counts after 10 minutes in a row.
close.title: A timer is running
close.text: If LumiPDF closes, it won’t ring and the time will be lost. Keep it running minimized instead?
settings.timer.askOnClose: Ask before closing while a timer runs
settings.timer.askOnCloseHint: Closing then minimizes LumiPDF instead, so the timer or alarm still rings.
tabs.label: Open documents
tabs.new: Open another document from the Library
welcome.language.title: Welcome to LumiPDF
welcome.language.text: A calm PDF reader for long study sessions. A few choices and you’re ready; you can change everything later in Settings.
welcome.language.label: Language
welcome.appearance.title: Light or dark?
welcome.appearance.text: How LumiPDF itself looks. Pages have their own reading theme, next.
welcome.reading.title: Your reading theme
welcome.reading.text: Dark pages are recoloured as they are drawn, so text stays as sharp as the original. Photos keep their colours.
welcome.library.title: Bring your PDFs
welcome.library.text: Add the folders where you keep course material, and the cloud drives you use. Files stay where they are.
welcome.library.goodnotesHint: Show notebooks from GoodNotes Auto Backup in the Library.
welcome.reading.calloutText: right-click the moon in the top bar to switch theme and adjust brightness. A normal click turns dark pages on or off.
tools.label: Annotation tools
tools.drawHint: Hold Shift for a straight line
tools.eraserHint: Drag over what you want to remove
tools.noteHint: Click on the page to add a note
note.title: Note
notes.empty: Nothing marked yet. Select text to highlight it, or use the pen, highlighter and sticky notes in the top bar.
settings.shortcuts.tools: Tools: hand, select, highlight, pen, highlighter, eraser, note, snip
tools.snipHint: Drag over an area to copy it or save it as a PNG
snip.name: {title} — page {page}
export.title: Export a copy
export.intro: LumiPDF saves a new PDF and never changes the original.
export.annotationsHint.one: {count} annotation, kept editable in other PDF readers
export.annotationsHint.other: {count} annotations, kept editable in other PDF readers
export.noAnnotations: This PDF has no annotations yet.
export.compressOff: Pictures stay exactly as they are.
export.level.noneText: Pictures stay exactly as they are.
export.level.recommendedText: Sharp on screen and on paper, much smaller.
export.level.strongText: Smallest file, for reading on screens and sharing.
export.protectionKept: The copy keeps the same password and restrictions.
export.unlockHint: The copy opens without a password.
export.unlockOwnerHint: Needs the owner password that set these restrictions.
export.annotationsBlocked: This PDF doesn’t allow annotations, so they stay out unless you remove the protection.
welcome.whatsnew.title: What’s new in LumiPDF {version}
welcome.whatsnew.text: Everything that changed since LuminaPDF 1.x, at a glance.
error.notFound: The file can’t be found. It may have been moved, renamed or deleted.
error.invalidPdf: This PDF is damaged and can’t be read.
error.overwrite: Choose a different name: LumiPDF never overwrites the original PDF.
error.password: The password for this PDF isn’t correct.
error.needsPassword: This PDF needs its password to be exported.
error.ownerPassword: The owner password isn’t correct, so the copy can’t be unlocked.
error.noAnnotations: This PDF doesn’t allow adding annotations. Export it without them, or remove the protection with the owner password.
error.updateGone: The update isn’t ready any more. Check for updates again.
error.notOpen: This document isn’t open any more.
error.notInLibrary: This file isn’t in your library any more.
settings.update.modeMoveToApps: Move LumiPDF to your Applications folder so it can install updates itself; until then it opens the download page.
open.dropHereHint: Each PDF opens in its own tab.
settings.beta.welcomeHint: Shows the whole welcome again, as on a new computer. Your settings stay.
settings.beta.perfHint: Shows frame rate and drawing times, and writes LumiPDF-performance.log on your Desktop to send to the developer.
nav.backTitle: Go back to where you followed the link ({shortcut})
password.rememberHint: Kept in Windows Credential Manager or the Mac Keychain, so this file opens without asking.
export.printTitle: Print the document, with the annotations if they're included
sheets.addImageHint: Add a picture from a file (or paste one with Ctrl/⌘+V)
reader.originalTitle: Show the page in its original colours (or hold O)
photoTrain.title: Photo training (beta)
photoTrain.saved: Saved to LumiPDF-esempi on the Desktop
settings.beta.intro: Tools for testers. They are only in beta versions.
settings.beta.photoHint: Right-click an image in dark mode and say whether it is a photo. The correction applies at once and the example is saved in LumiPDF-esempi on the Desktop, to send to the developer.
